lessons.trigger_condition: tablet runtime starts or restarts while scheduled updater or Termux:Boot readiness is missing, legacy, or unknown
lessons.symptom_summary: a device can appear configured while the updater or boot supervisor is not actually ready to keep the running checkout aligned with protected main
lessons.fix_pattern: self-prepare the updater idempotently, repair legacy boot scripts, hold on unknown Termux:Boot readiness, require boot heartbeat evidence, and retain fast-forward-only updates

lessons.trigger_condition: exact-grade prices or card-analysis dependencies reach the tablet without complete provenance or manifest/regression coverage
lessons.symptom_summary: unsupported grade prices or a partial stale tablet checkout can look usable even though required grading, identity, market, or security dependencies are absent
lessons.fix_pattern: require machine-readable exact-grade provenance, fail closed when FX or evidence is invalid, include the complete card/market/security dependency chain in the tablet manifest, and run it in current-runtime and delivery gates

lessons.trigger_condition: KR/JP/EN evidence, generation hints, verified learning, and market candidates are combined without the same edition and exact-card identity boundary
lessons.symptom_summary: a same-name or same-number card from a different edition or conflicting generation evidence can contaminate automatic identity or pricing
lessons.fix_pattern: keep KR/JP/EN evidence explicit, isolate verified learning by edition, fail closed on generation conflicts, and require exact card-number plus edition matching for automatic market linkage

lessons.trigger_condition: scheduled data refresh or GPT Drive packaging runs while protected-main rules or freshness windows are active
lessons.symptom_summary: direct-main publication is unsafe and a stale package can leave the tablet behind even when collection itself succeeded
lessons.fix_pattern: publish validated data through a candidate branch and PR with exact-SHA checks, never direct-push protected main, and build fresh GPT Drive packages on a bounded cadence before tablet sync windows

lessons.trigger_condition: multiple learners or ambiguous UNKNOWN/confirmed editions update verified card identity state
lessons.symptom_summary: stale concurrent writers or cross-edition evidence can overwrite valid learning or promote an ambiguous sample
lessons.fix_pattern: serialize the full learning transaction, permit UNKNOWN to confirmed promotion only with verified evidence, reject confirmed-edition conflicts, and partition similarity support by edition

lessons.trigger_condition: Drive/rclone packages, rollback metadata, locks, or running service identity are accepted without strict structure and exact build binding
lessons.symptom_summary: malformed or redirected sync state can otherwise be mistaken for a trusted current tablet runtime
lessons.fix_pattern: use strict duplicate-safe manifests, bind service identity and running build SHA to the expected main SHA, harden rclone and lock/rollback metadata, and fail closed on trust-boundary violations

lessons.trigger_condition: game, edition, product type, set, rarity, variant, or generation evidence is incomplete or conflicting before automatic selection or market binding
lessons.symptom_summary: UNKNOWN or ambiguous card dimensions can be silently collapsed into a plausible but incorrect generation or price candidate
lessons.fix_pattern: classify game, edition, product type, set, rarity, and variant independently; block UNKNOWN/conflict automatic selection; do not invent generation; bind market evidence only to the exact resolved identity

lessons.trigger_condition: edition/market mapping changes or an FX refresh fails, expires, or returns zero/non-finite values
lessons.symptom_summary: the browser can otherwise display a converted KRW amount using stale or invalid rates and blur edition identity with sales-market routing
lessons.fix_pattern: separate card edition from sales market, require fresh finite positive FX at render time, clear FX state after refresh failure, and keep the regression in recurring runtime/delivery gates
